Today unfolded as a textured, moderately challenging day for Alex, shaped by the lingering effects of poor sleep and a steady stream of digital demands. By day’s end, despite moderate stress and fatigue, Alex remained composed, quietly resilient, and ready to seek restorative calm after work.
